limitations: Local pilot auth (SQLite accounts, scrypt, cookie sessions); not production IAM/SSO, no MFA, no e-mail recovery, no lockout notifications.
Default HTTP on loopback; network exposure needs a TLS proxy and explicit allowed_hosts; X-Forwarded-For is not trusted.
Login rate limit is strict but keyed by client IP: behind NAT/proxy one client can lock others out for 15 minutes.

SQLite single writer with synchronous=FULL: about 27 write transactions/s in the test container; fine for tens of editors. A long CLI import holds the write lock (server writes may get 503 busy meanwhile).
Keyset pagination on (updated_at, id): an object edited during a page walk can be skipped; clients restart the walk after writes.
Real Astana data: R05 reports 0 confirmed records (egress blocked); demo data is synthetic and labelled.
R01 imported R02 at 3d2b8b9; review fixes and migration 4 after it need a re-import at code_commit.
